subject.title: Vertex beta INVALID_ARGUMENT can wedge long sessions without actionable recovery

question: How should OpenClaw recover from generic LiteLLM/Vertex beta 400 `INVALID_ARGUMENT` responses that lack token or context wording?
rationale: The source gap is narrow, but generic `INVALID_ARGUMENT` can mean several provider-side problems, so automation should not choose compaction, model fallback, session reset, non-beta routing, or diagnostics-only behavior without maintainer intent and live proof.

options.title: Prove and add narrow provider recovery
options.body: Require a live LiteLLM/Vertex beta reproduction, then add the smallest provider-owned classifier and session cleanup behavior for that exact shape.

options.title: Fold into broader session recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open but route the behavior under a broader provider-rejected-session recovery design with the related context and image rejection issues.

options.title: Diagnostics only for now
options.body: Leave automatic recovery unchanged and only improve redacted logs/user guidance until the provider error shape is better understood.

recommendation.title: Prove and add narrow provider recovery
recommendation.body: Require a live LiteLLM/Vertex beta reproduction, then add the smallest provider-owned classifier and session cleanup behavior for that exact shape.
